author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Step 1. You have to do everything with AI 100%, it won't scale and you have to baby-sit the AI, it probably takes longer than you do it by hand.
Step 2. After you have done it for a few weeks, you have collected a few hundred repetitive tasks in your Claude Code sessions. Then ask Claude Code to harvest your chat sessions and build an auto router and sub-agents to do the work for you
Step 3. You just automated 80% of your old job away, now you can spend more time working on newer cooler stuff.
